gold.user: As a user of the Twilio API, I want to retrieve a list of all my toll-free phone numbers associated with my account so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON response containing an array of toll-free phone numbers, including details such as the phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to create a new toll-free phone number for my application using the Twilio API, so that I can provide a dedicated contact number for my customers.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters such as the phone number and friendly name, and return a JSON response with the details of the newly created toll-free phone number, including its SID and status.
